purpose: Request a bounded owner review of the exact attempt-003 terrain-screen result without converting that review into vertical-datum, radar-processing, or scientific authority.

decision_request.question: Does the reviewer accept the exact attempt-003 evidence as satisfying the bounded owner terrain-result review while preserving every stated limitation and deferred gate?
approval_effect: record that the owner reviewed and accepted the exact terrain-screen result and its limitations
permit only the human-review gate in the terrain-readiness audit to be reassessed from defer to pass after exact response lock and reconciliation
retain the attempt-003 terrain result as gross-artifact and map-surface evidence only
decision_request.revision_effect: Return the exact requested revision without changing observed metrics, thresholds, failed attempts, or external artifacts.
decision_request.deferral_effect: Keep the owner terrain-result review unresolved and release no action.

does_not_authorize: approve or execute a vertical-datum method
sign in, accept terms, install software, or approve a privileged prompt
use GEOID or NONE in Sentinel-1 processing
acquire an independent DEM, orbit auxiliary, or additional satellite product
process Sentinel pixels or promote the DEM to radar-ready
publish DEM-derived raster imagery, scientific change, interpretation, attribution, or emergency guidance
erase or reclassify attempt-001, attempt-002, or any deferred audit gate
limitations: The tracked review bundle cannot contain the external DEM-derived map pixels; it binds their paths and hashes through the result receipt.
Model visual inspection does not substitute for this human review or independent elevation validation.
A completed approval can close only the owner terrain-result review; every other deferred gate remains separate.
